Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I have been using this grill for a couple of months now.  I do like it and it is pretty easy to clean up.  There are a couple of things I would like to see improved on the grill and they probably run across the complete line of grills.  The tank weighing mechanism does not work very well.  It might just be the friction of moving parts but it is very inaccurate.  The tank I have (a standard run of the mill tank) will hit the axle when it is nearly full, messing up the reading.  Another point is that the top of the grill is pretty flat.  That allows rain water to puddle up on the top (with or without a cover).  If the top had a slope or radius, that would allow the water to drain and not puddle up.  On a positive note,  I do like the fact that all  the edges and corners are softened so the grill cover doesn't snag going on or off.  The grilling that I have done does taste better than my previous grill.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
Looking at sale grills at my local big box on Memorial Day. I had owned charcoal grills in the past, but had issues with consistent cooking and maintaining temperature and food safety. I wanted gas this time, but was wary of the inferior quality problems with many of the big box cheap brands. I wanted a quality grill, and was willing to pay a premium for it since it came with a great warranty. So I bought the E210. I don't grill that often, just occasionally. I love the convenience of turning on the grill, having it come straight up to temp for burnoff, then scrape and cook in about 10 minutes. It maintains a steady, safe temperature without flare ups.
  Even though my family is moving away from red meat, there are still a wide variety of things to cook, and this grill makes it easy. The compact size is perfect for our needs. We don't do entertaining and parties, so the E210 is just right. And if we did entertain, it really wouldn't be a problem with this grill. Love the look and function. Would recommend watching an assembly walk through video before assembling. Instructions are pretty good, but there were a couple of things I had to redo during the process. Overall I Highly recommend.

So after another $100 grill fell apart, I made the investment into a better quality grill as me and the family use it at least 5 times a week. Bought it on Easter as we had a cookout planned with family, and the old grill fell apart the day before. Have been impressed ever since.
Results.Title: Perfect size for everyday grilling

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I had to sell my huge barbecue last year.  With my new deck there just wasn't the space and with only the 2 of us, I thought perhaps I didn't need a barbecue at all.  Well...by this spring, I had to have me a barbecue!  This one is just perfect due to it's size. It has the amazing 10 year Weber warranty.  And I LOVE the feature that it can tell you, by weight (how brilliant), how much propane you have left.  The inside height is also perfect for my chicken drumstick cooker.  Don't have a single complaint.
Results.Title: Perfect size and features!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I wanted to purchase a Genesis series grill last year as it seemed to me that the Spirit wasn’t quite as sturdy. 
When I decided to make a purchase this spring I found that the smaller  Genesis model I had looked at was no longer available. 
I didn’t want a larger (or more expensive) model so I took another look at the Spirit 210. Either I didn’t remember it correctly or Weber made some improvements to it, and the price had just come down as well. 
It seems to be well made, sturdy and does the job perfectly. I also purchased a cover which I highly recommend. 
This is at least my fourth Weber grill. They have great Customer Service, and this has a 10 year warranty as well.
Results.Title: Good Grill lower price

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
